verdict.rationale: Klaviyo exposes a broad REST API (campaigns, flows, arbitrary data ingestion) and SDKs, showing strong developer surface (klaviyo-docs-7, klaviyo-docs-8, klaviyo-docs-21, klaviyo-docs-23), but there is no evidence that all UI-exclusive capabilities—like the drag-and-drop email/SMS editor, AI subject-line generator, or Composer/Customer Agent AI features—are exposed via API (klaviyo-docs-11, klaviyo-docs-20, klaviyo-docs-25, klaviyo-docs-26 describe these as UI-only features with no API counterpart mentioned). missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for drag-and-drop template building, AI subject-line/Composer features, and any documented parity statement between UI and API capabilities.
